metadata.description: Internal Claude Code plugin marketplace for MediaInterface

plugins.name: azure-devops
plugins.description: OBSOLETE — replaced by ado-toolkit (Azure DevOps via the az CLI) and removed soon; install ado-toolkit instead. MCP-based Azure DevOps Server integration — pipeline analysis, PR workflows, changelogs.

plugins.name: ado-toolkit
plugins.description: Azure DevOps Server via the az CLI — work items (create, update, comment), pull requests (review, create, update, comment), pipeline failure analysis and changelogs. Standalone, no development process assumed.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Remove AI writing patterns to make text sound more natural and human

plugins.name: claude-md-improver
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that keeps CLAUDE.md files in sync with staged changes before each commit

plugins.name: sdd-kit
plugins.description: The tools for our Spec-Driven Development workflow — decision records, lessons learned, a design-spec writer, a spec→PR gate, and a deep PR review. Builds on ado-toolkit for Azure DevOps.

plugins.name: guardian
plugins.description: Tools for the guardians (the Hüter-Trio) to do their job — watching over the whole repository and its architecture, the Memory Bank included, so the codebase stays consistent and doesn't drift.
